mapper.select: SELECT ll.user_id, ll.dates, ll.create_time, u.dates register_dates, u.create_time register_date, u.pkg, IFNULL(uh.address, 'IN') country, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, u.create_time, ll.create_time) register_cohort_day, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, u.dates, ll.dates) register_day, uvm.pvn register_version, ll.pvn version FROM diversion.login_log ll INNER JOIN diversion.`user` u on (ll.user_id = u.id) LEFT JOIN diversion.user_hema uh on (uh.aid = u.aid and uh.pkg = u.pkg) LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, min(pvn) pvn FROM diversion.user_version group by user_id) uvm on (uvm.user_id = ll.user_id) WHERE ll.dates = #{dates} limit #{rows} offset #{startRows}
